snippet.title: Monsters and Me | Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Monsters and Me launches on PC (Steam & GOG) today!

After a waste plant goes very wrong, the city is overrun with slime mutant rage freaks — and you’re one of the last humans left standing. Armed with guns, perks, supers, and questionable decision-making skills, you’ll fight wave after wave of disgusting monsters in this fast, chaotic, round-based top-down arcade shooter.

It’s fast.
It’s chaotic.
It’s funny.
It’s gross.

And yes — there are a lot of guns.

🔥 What to expect:
18 upgradable weapons (shotguns, rifles, flamethrowers, you name it)
12 special abilities with ridiculous upgrade paths
5 perks to boost your build (and your survival odds)
4 playable characters, each with their own vibe and catchphrases
Solo play or local co-op for maximum chaos
Randomized waves, power-ups, and weapons — every run is a mess (on purpose)

One run you’re in control.
The next run everything explodes.
That’s Monsters and Me.

🧪 Release Date: February 10
💻 Platforms: PC via Steam & GOG
📌 Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644160/Monsters_and_Me/

Welcome to the apocalypse, bro.
Don’t forget to reload.
